title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
   

 ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
   

 Job Description
   

 The ACI Card and Merchant Management (CMM) product line provides industry\-leading solutions that enable financial institutions to manage transactions across the card payment lifecycle. Our products are used by card acquirers, issuers, and organizations connected to global payment networks such as Visa, Mastercard, Discover, AMEX, and JCB.
   

 As an DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with development, QA, and operations teams to build, maintain, and improve the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support the CMM product suite. This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about automation, cloud technologies, continuous improvement, and delivering reliable, scalable solutions.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 \- Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable software delivery.
   

 \- Assist in automating deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational processes.
   

 \- Maintain and troubleshoot development, test, and production environments.
   

 \- Work with engineering teams to improve system reliability, performance, and scalability.
   

 \- Monitor applications and infrastructure, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
   

 \- Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code initiatives and configuration management.
   

 \- Participate in incident investigation, root cause analysis, and problem resolution activities.
   

 \- Support containerized and cloud\-based deployments using modern DevOps practices.
   

 \- Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks.
   

 \- Collaborate within Agile teams and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
   

 \- Leverage AI\-powered tools and technologies to improve engineering productivity, automation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.
   

  

  

 Minimum Qualifications
   

 \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

 \- 1–3 years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, System Administration, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
   

 \- Strong desire to learn new technologies and continuously improve technical skills.
   

 \- Demonstrated problem\-solving ability and willingness to take ownership of tasks and challenges.
   

 \- Strong collaboration and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
   

 \- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
   

 \- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently when required.
   

  

 Experience with:
   

 \- DevOps principles and practices.
   

 \- Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
   

 \- Automation tools for build, test, deployment, and operational processes.
   

 \- Cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
   

 \- Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems.
   

 \- Source control systems such as Git.
   

 \- Basic database knowledge, preferably Oracle and/or PostgreSQL.
   

 \- Scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
   

 \- Monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting tools.
   

 \- Interest in adopting emerging AI technologies to drive efficiency, innovation, and continuous improvement within the engineering organization.
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

 \- Experience using AI\-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to improve productivity and code quality.
   

 \- Ability to apply AI solutions to software development, testing, automation, operational workflows, and problem resolution.
   

 \- Docker and Kubernetes containerization technologies.
   

 \- Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Ansible, or equivalent automation platforms.
   

 \- Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK, or EFK.
   

 \- Familiarity with Oracle or DB2 databases.
   

 \- Understanding of networking fundamentals, security concepts, and cloud\-native architectures.
   

  

  

 Highly Desired Qualifications
   

 \- Previous experience supporting payment processing or financial services applications.
   

 \- Knowledge of card payment networks including Visa, Mastercard, Discover, AMEX, or JCB.
   

 \- Understanding of payment industry concepts and transaction processing workflows.
   

 \- Experience working within Agile development methodologies.
   

 \- Passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

 \- Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve engineering efficiency through automation and AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

  

 Core Capabilities
   

 We seek colleagues who embody ACI's core capabilities and contribute to our innovative engineering culture:
   

 \- Ensure Accountability: Hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
   

 \- Drives Results: Consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances.
   

 \- Customer Focus: Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer\-centric solutions.
   

 \- Cultivate Innovation: Create new and better ways for the organization to succeed.
   

 \- Collaborates: Build partnerships and work effectively across teams and geographies.
   

 \- Courage: Step up to address difficult issues and say what needs to be said.
   

  

  

 AI Readiness
   

 At ACI, AI is becoming an integral part of our engineering culture. Successful candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and practical application of AI technologies in software engineering. Candidates should be prepared to discuss:
   

 \- How they currently use AI tools in their development workflow.
   

 \- Examples of AI\-assisted coding, testing, automation, or problem\-solving.
   

 \- Their approach to responsible and effective AI adoption.
   

 \- Opportunities they see for leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
   

  

  

 Work Authorization
   

 Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full\-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.
   

  

 Why Join ACI?
   

 In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
   

 Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
   

 ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
   

 Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
   

 Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

****About The Role:****
 CrowdStrike's engineering organization depends on shared infrastructure platforms that power critical product capabilities. These platforms need dedicated engineering ownership to operate reliably, scale safely, harden for security, and mature into self\-service capabilities that teams can depend on.
   

  

 You'll own production infrastructure that spans multiple cloud providers and regions, serving engineering teams across the organization. The work is equal parts platform engineering and operational excellence — building automation, hardening security, establishing governance, and enabling consuming teams to adopt these platforms effectively. You'll also help shape what comes next as the team's scope grows.

title: Software Test Engineer (Cloud)
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**Arista Networks** 
 is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
 



 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
 



 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
 



  





  





**Who You’ll Work With** 




  





 Arista Networks is seeking high\-caliber self\-motivated test engineers for its enterprise and cloud\-managed WiFi products. This role will involve testing and validating complex cloud infrastructure and services that power WiFi networks, ensuring they perform at scale and meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and efficiency. You will play a key role in the design, development, and execution of comprehensive test plans for cloud\-based Wi\-Fi solutions, working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver industry\-leading products.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* Lead the testing efforts on the cloud infrastructure that supports Wi\-Fi networks, ensuring scalability, performance, and resilience in different environments (Cloud and On\-premise deployments)
* Design and execute performance, scalability, and load tests to ensure the cloud services can handle heavy traffic and provide reliable WiFi services under various conditions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to conduct integration tests for cloud\-based services that interface with hardware. Ensure seamless interactions between cloud APIs and the Access Points.
* Create solution based detailed test plans, test cases, and test reports for all stages of the development lifecycle. Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
* “Own” the feature and core area of the product, and be the single point of contact and testing expert for your deliverables.
* Track defects and issues using defect management systems, ensuring they are escalated appropriately and resolved in a timely manner.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, provide feedback, and ensure high\-quality product delivery.
* Participate in escalations debugging and reproduce the complex issues reported by customers.
* Mentor junior team members and share best practices in testing and cloud\-based WiFi solution validation.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in E\&TC/EE/CE/CS/IT or a related field; Master’s degree a plus.
* 10 \- 15 years of experience in testing \& troubleshooting Cloud technologies, virtualization, Microservices, and debugging complex software
* Good experience in working with Hadoop \& Big data technologies like HDFS, HBase, Spark, Kafka streaming, and Elasticsearch
* Good working knowledge of Database (SQL) and Server side validations.
* Experience with various performance testing methods (Load test, Stress test, and capacity test) will be a plus.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals around scalability, elasticity, availability, and fault tolerance.
* Experience in Networking Tools and networking fundamentals across the OSI stack is a plus.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills and proven expertise in creating test methodologies and writing test plans.
* Strong knowledge of Linux systems.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python will be a plus.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Adaptive to learning new things and technologies

title: AI Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 AI Infrastructure Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Microsoft Azure Data Services
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 AI Agents \& Workflow Integration
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Azure, you will own significant portions of the end\-to\-end architecture and engineering of optimized compute infrastructure for large\-scale AI and machine learning systems. You will design scalable distributed training environments, model\-serving foundations, automation patterns and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost\-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, cloud modernization, regulated workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Azure\-based AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end architecture and design of optimized Azure compute infrastructure for large\-scale AI/ML systems, including distributed training, GPU/accelerated compute, container platforms and model\-serving environments.
   

  

 Design and tune large\-scale Azure GPU clusters and distributed training systems using services such as Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure NetApp Files, Azure Virtual Network, Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions, including accelerator selection, networking and high\-throughput storage design.
   

  

 Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Azure, applying deep knowledge of Azure AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, security and cost levers.
   

  

 Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade\-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
   

  

 Drive architecture decision\-making by documenting rationale, trade\-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
   

  

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
   

  

 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
   

  

 Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large\-scale solutions.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on experience with Azure AI infrastructure services including Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure NetApp Files, Azure Virtual Network, Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
   

  

 Experience architecting GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, high\-throughput storage, container platforms and secure cloud networking.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of Bicep/ARM/Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, InfraOps, MLOps, observability and incident response practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize Azure AI infrastructure for performance, power, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
   

  

 Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable infrastructure patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where AI infrastructure must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost\-control requirements.
   

  

 Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, high\-performance storage, low\-latency model serving and model optimization techniques.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise architecture governance, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

Combining an intuitive platform, AI\-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high\-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning.

Learn more at www.litmos.com.

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Network Operations Engineer to join our CloudOps team and keep our infrastructure secure, patched, and available around the clock. You'll monitor and support a multi\-cloud environment, primarily Azure, with an AWS footprint, spanning Windows, Linux, and SQL Server systems. Coverage runs follow\-the\-sun, so you'll be part of a rotation that ensures alerts never go unwatched, wherever in the world they fire.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Monitor \& Respond**
* Watch infrastructure health, performance, and security across Azure, AWS, Windows, Linux, and SQL Server using our monitoring and observability tools.
* Triage incoming alerts, assess severity, and take action — or escalate with clear context — as part of a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation.
* Diagnose and resolve incidents using established runbooks, and document what happened, why, and how it was fixed.


**Patch \& Maintain**
* Plan, schedule, and execute patches and updates across cloud resources, servers, and databases, coordinating maintenance windows to minimize business impact.
* Keep patch and compliance records current to meet security and regulatory requirements.


**Improve \& Report**
* Track SLA, MTTR, and MTBF metrics, and report on system reliability to stakeholders.
* Contribute to post\-incident reviews and refine runbooks, alert thresholds, and escalation policies based on what you learn.
* Flag opportunities to automate repetitive operational work.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 2–4 years in cloud operations, systems administration, or network operations.
* Network Configuration experience:\- set up and troubleshot VPNs, DNS, subnets, and routing.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure; exposure to AWS is a plus.
* Comfort administering both Windows and Linux systems, plus familiarity with SQL Server.
* Experience with monitoring/alerting tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or equivalent) and patch management processes.
* A track record of clear incident documentation and communication under pressure.
* Willingness to work a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation, including off\-hours coverage.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Azure certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-900\) or AWS equivalents.
* Scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM) or CI/CD pipelines.
* Background in SRE practices or backup/disaster recovery (RTO/RPO).


**Salary Range:** 
 ₹12,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 plus 10% bonus
   

  

 As a learning company we believe in the potential of everyone; if you don't have experience in all the details mentioned in this job post, then we still encourage you to apply and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity workplace employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities.
   

  

 Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

title: Technical Implementation Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**Technical Implementation Engineer — Customer Solutions \& Integrations**
**Role summary:** 
 Sits between Technical Implementation and Engineering — owns technical onboarding, data ingestion, and custom integration work for customers on the platform (ETM/VMDR context), with enough coding and
 **AI\-tooling fluency to automate repetitive implementation work rather than doing it manually each time.**
**Note \- Relocation to Pune is required for this role, Role may involve Night shifts. We work 3 days from Office in a week.**
* Core Responsibilities
+ Data ingestion \& onboarding: Build and validate CSV/bulk data ingestion pipelines into ETM (asset data, business context, criticality tags, third\-party vulnerability feeds)
+ API\-based integrations: Build custom solutions using Qualys APIs and third\-party APIs (ServiceNow, Jira, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender, SIEM/SOAR platforms, ticketing systems)
+ Customer\-facing technical work: Join customer calls to scope integration requirements, troubleshoot live issues, and walk technical stakeholders (network/security/IT teams) through implementation steps
+ Automation of implementation work itself: Use AI agents/scripting to templatize and speed up recurring implementation tasks (data mapping, connector setup, validation checks) rather than repeating manual work per customer
+ Documentation \& handoff: Produce clean runbooks/config docs so Support and the customer's own team can maintain the integration post\-go\-live


* AI \& Agentic Automation \- The engineer will be expected to use modern AI tooling as an engineering productivity layer. The role should be capable of evaluating and building workflows where AI/agents can assist with implementation activities such as:
+ Understanding customer integration requirements.
+ Mapping customer schemas to Qualys schemas.
+ Generating transformation logic.
+ Creating API integration code.
+ Analysing integration errors and logs.
+ Generating configuration templates.
+ Validating implementation prerequisites.
+ Generating customer\-specific implementation documentation.
+ Performing repetitive implementation checks.
+ Building internal agents that execute controlled implementation workflows.
+ Experience with tools such as GPT\-based agents, Claude\-based workflows, RAG, function/tool calling, MCP\-style integrations, RPA, or similar automation frameworks is valuable.
+ The expectation is not that the engineer is an AI researcher.
+ The expectation is that they understand how to apply AI safely and practically to reduce implementation effort and increase implementation consistency.


* Required Qualifications:
+ Programming proficiency (Python strongly preferred — scripting, API clients, data transformation)
+ Solid REST API experience (auth flows, pagination, rate limits, webhook handling)
+ Comfortable with CSV/structured data manipulation and data validation at scale
+ Working knowledge of at least one ticketing/ITSM platform integration (ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy)
+ Experience or strong aptitude with AI agent tooling (e.g., building/using agents for workflow automation — could be internal tooling, Claude/GPT\-based agents, or RPA\-adjacent tools)
+ Strong verbal communication — able to run technical discussions directly with customer engineering/network teams, not just write code


* Preferred Qualifications:
+ Prior exposure to Qualys VMDR/ETM, or a comparable VM platform (Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys competitors)
+ Experience with SOAR platforms or security automation
+ Familiarity with cloud platform APIs (AWS/Azure/GCP) for asset ingestion
+ Basic understanding of vulnerability management workflows (so they understand why the data matters, not just how to move it)

title: Professional Services Engineer, Actimize
description:

And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

 So, what's the role all about?
   

  

 As a Professional Services Engineer, you will join a dynamic, customer\-facing team responsible for implementing and delivering NICE Actimize Financial Crime Prevention solutions for leading global financial institutions. You will play a critical role in configuring, customizing, deploying, and supporting Actimize solutions across Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Payments Fraud, and Trading Compliance domains.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with customers, business analysts, solution architects, and implementation teams to understand business requirements and deliver intelligent, scalable, and innovative solutions. You will gain exposure to complex regulatory compliance challenges while working with the market leader in Financial Crime and Compliance technology.
   

  

 How will you make an impact?
   

  

 Solution Development \& Implementation
   

  

* Develop, configure, and customize product features according to solution designs and enterprise software standards.
* Implement and configure NICE Actimize applications for customer\-specific requirements.
* Setup new environments and deploy solutions across development, testing, and production environments.
* Independently develop and deliver enterprise\-grade software features and functionalities.
* Participate in solution design discussions and technical implementation planning.

* Support customers by troubleshooting and resolving functional and technical issues.

* Collaborate with R\&D, Professional Services, Customer Support, and other internal teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Participate in customer deployments and occasionally support customer engagements across different time zones.


 Engineering Excellence \& Innovation
   

  

* Develop utilities, tools, and automation solutions that improve delivery efficiency and operational scalability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams within Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, and implementation practices.
* Maintain high\-quality standards while working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


 Have you got what it takes?
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree with relevant practical experience.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in software implementation, customization, or enterprise application development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL and PostgreSQL databases.
* Experience handling large\-scale data volumes and complex database environments.
* Experience working with Oracle, MS SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in global and matrix\-based environments.
* Exposure to Unix/Linux environments and command\-line operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical ability with a self\-learning mindset.
* Ability to work independently and deliver complex assignments with minimal supervision.
* Experience developing secure, scalable, multi\-user enterprise software applications.

* Exposure to cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Previous experience in Professional Services, implementation, or customer\-facing technical roles.
* Experience or knowledge of NICE Actimize platform development.
* Familiarity with enterprise application deployment and environment setup.


 What makes you stand out?
   

  

* Excellent attention to detail and task management skills.
* Proven ability to operate successfully in complex delivery environments.
* Strong collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders.
* Passion for learning new technologies and solving complex customer challenges.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced, and customer\-focused environments.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

 At Red Hat, our interns are an integral part of the team. They don’t get relegated to busywork or unimportant tasks, but participate in the day\-to\-day work and are active contributors to their team.
   

  

 We are currently looking for Software Engineering interns to join us in Pune or Bangalore. You will be part of a cohort of interns and have the opportunity to work on multiple projects within Global Engineering while also receiving learning and curriculum on different technologies. * Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster platform operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat certifications (EX280 / EX380 / RHCE); exposure to Rafay, vCluster, NVIDIA Run:ai or Red Hat OpenShift AI; MLOps or AI\-platform operations (model\-serving endpoints, GPU scheduling, quota governance).

 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.

 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.

* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:

* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**

* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.

 We are building a cutting\-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core – providing unparalleled visibility and control.

 ****DevOps Engineer****
 with a strong background in
 ****cloud infrastructure and architecture****

 ****team leadership****

 ****Microsoft Azure****

 ****CI/CD maturity and operational posture****
 .

 Cloud Infrastructure Management

 CI/CD

description:

 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our infrastructure team with expertise across Cloud Deployments, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Office 365, Zerto, Rubrik, VMware, and NSX\-T. This hands\-on, automation\-heavy role focuses on system reliability, scalability, and proactive problem prevention. You will be responsible for building and maintaining resilient infrastructure, automating repetitive tasks, monitoring, and improving
   

  

 performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 
 (Additional duties may be assigned as required)
   

  

* Own the design and roadmap for hybrid identity (Entra ID and on\-prem AD), including conditional access and secure authentication standards.
* Design, deploy, and administer VMware vSphere and NSX\-T environments, including capacity planning and secure network topologies.
* Define and own the DR strategy for Zerto and Rubrik, ensuring RTO/RPO and compliance requirements are met.
* Plan and lead workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure.
* Define SLIs/SLOs and design monitoring, alerting, and incident response workflows for production services.
* Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules; set IaC standards for the team.
* Develop automation frameworks in Python/PowerShell, including self\-healing and proactive detection.
* Design and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent).
* Own the automated vulnerability patch management program.
* Optimize Office 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune) for security and performance.
* Lead response and resolution for high\-impact incidents; act as on\-call escalation point.
* Conduct blameless postmortems and drive remediation to closure.
* Mentor SRE team members and review scripts, Terraform, and change plans.
* Represent infrastructure in security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


**REQUIRED SKILLS**
* 6–10 years in SRE on Windows\-based production environments, including ownership of platform reliability.
* Deep expertise in VMware (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, NSX\-T), including capacity planning and architecture design.
* Expert\-level Microsoft Entra ID and on\-prem Active Directory: hybrid identity design, conditional access strategy, identity protection, and troubleshooting at scale.
* Strong programming/scripting in Python and PowerShell, with the ability to build reusable automation frameworks and self\-healing mechanisms. Infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform, including module design and DRY principles.
* CI/CD and GitOps experience (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent).
* Designing and implementing observability: defining SLIs/SLOs and building dashboards and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK.
* DR design and ownership with Zerto and Rubrik, including RTO/RPO planning, DR testing, and compliance.
* Strong networking knowledge: virtual network topology design, firewalls, load balancing, and DNS.


**Preferred Skills**
* Production experience with AWS or Azure, including Secure Landing Zone design.
* Experience planning and executing workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure.
* Kubernetes and Linux/Unix production experience.
* Ansible or similar configuration management tools.
* Experience owning vulnerability and patch management programs at scale.
* Experience supporting security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO).
* Relevant certifications (VCP, AZ\-104/AZ\-305, SC\-300, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or equivalent).
* Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical initiatives.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in complex hybrid environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting designs to stakeholders.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.

* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.

* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.

The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

title: Principal Engineer, Real-time Payments (Technology & Architecture)
description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer, Real\-time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

 Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
   

  

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution

title: Kafka & DevOps / Streaming Platform Engineer
description:
***Location:***
*Pune (Baner)* 




***Job Type:***
*Full time Work from Office* 




***Experience***
*: 3–5 years, hands\-on* 




  





**We are hiring a Kafka and DevOps / Streaming Platform Engineer.** 




  





 At
 **VoiseTech** 
 , we are building a high\-scale AdTech platform designed to process billions of real\-time events every day. We are looking for an engineer who combines deep Apache Kafka experience with strong DevOps and infrastructure skills.
 



 This is not a role where Kafka is simply consumed as a managed cloud service. You will work close to the infrastructure — designing, deploying, operating, and performance\-tuning our streaming stack across self\-managed Kafka, Kubernetes, and dedicated bare\-metal infrastructure.
 



  





**What you will work with** 




 Apache Kafka \| Kafka KRaft \| Kubernetes \| Docker \| Linux \| ClickHouse \| Redis \| MongoDB \| FastAPI \| Prometheus \| Grafana \| CI/CD \| Bare Metal
 



 Exposure to Apache Flink is a strong plus.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 •       Deploy, configure, administer, and upgrade self\-managed Apache Kafka clusters
 



 •       Own Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention, consumer groups, and capacity planning
 



 •       Diagnose production issues including consumer lag, broker failures, partition imbalance, rebalancing, and throughput bottlenecks
 



 •       Build and operate Kubernetes and Docker infrastructure for high\-throughput services
 



 •       Work with ClickHouse, Redis, and MongoDB infrastructure
 



 •       Benchmark systems for QPS, throughput, latency, network utilization, CPU, memory, and scalability
 



 •       Build monitoring, alerting, and observability using Prometheus and Grafana
 



 •       Automate infrastructure and operational workflows using Bash, Python, and CI/CD
 



 •       Participate in production troubleshooting, disaster recovery, and performance engineering
 



 •       Help us continuously improve reliability as traffic scales by orders of magnitude
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 You should have 3–5 years of hands\-on engineering experience, including meaningful production experience with Apache Kafka. We specifically want someone who has installed, configured, operated, and troubleshot Kafka clusters — not only developed Kafka producers and consumers.
 



 Strong fundamentals in Linux, networking, Docker/Kubernetes, and distributed systems are important. Experience with some of the following is a plus: Kafka KRaft, Flink, Kafka Connect, ClickHouse administration, Redis, MongoDB, Helm, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and bare\-metal infrastructure.
 



  





**How we think about AI** 




 We want engineers who are AI\-driven, not AI\-dependent. Use AI aggressively to move faster — investigation, automation, coding, debugging, and documentation — but understand the systems you operate, validate the output, and be capable of diagnosing production problems independently.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




 You will not just maintain infrastructure. You will help build the streaming backbone of VoiseTech’s AdTech platform from the ground up, work on real high\-throughput distributed\-systems problems, and have end\-to\-end ownership from infrastructure to production performance.
 



  





 Interested? Send us your profile or reach out directly.

title: Security Consultant II
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Security Consultant owning VAPT and Red Teaming engagements across infrastructure, network, web, mobile, API, thick\-client, cloud and AI/LLM environments. The role involves identifying and exploiting security weaknesses, simulating real\-world adversary techniques, developing proof\-of\-concept exploits, documenting findings and providing clear remediation guidance to technical and business stakeholders. The consultant will also support purple\-team activities, mentor junior resources and contribute to offensive security capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing across infrastructure, network, web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, thick\-client and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Identify, validate and document vulnerabilities using manual testing techniques and automated security tools; develop PoCs to demonstrate exploitability.
* Conduct database security testing and configuration reviews across MySQL, Oracle and NoSQL platforms.
* Plan, execute and document Red Team engagements simulating real\-world threat actor TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Execute attack chains covering initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
* Conduct Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social\-engineering campaigns and endpoint security bypass exercises.
* Use and adapt adversary\-emulation tools and frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit and Caldera.
* Collaborate with Blue Teams during purple\-team exercises to validate and improve detection and response capabilities.
* Perform security testing of AI/ML and LLM\-based applications, including prompt injection, jailbreak, model extraction and adversarial\-input testing.
* Apply relevant AI security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS to identify AI\-specific risks.
* Prepare detailed technical reports covering assessment methodology, vulnerabilities, severity, evidence, PoCs and remediation recommendations.
* Present security findings and risk implications clearly to technical teams, management and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, APT techniques, malware trends and offensive\-security research and incorporate relevant techniques into assessments.
* Mentor junior consultants on penetration\-testing tools, techniques and methodologies and contribute to internal security capability building.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in VAPT, Red Teaming and Application Security, including client\-facing or security advisory exposure.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OSSTMM, NIST and CIS security frameworks.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP, and network/infrastructure security.
* Hands\-on experience with penetration\-testing and vulnerability\-assessment tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nikto, ZAP and MobSF.
* Ability to perform manual penetration testing beyond automated scanner capabilities.
* Working experience with scripting and exploit development using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Working knowledge of security assessment across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, report\-writing and client communication skills.
* BE/B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
* Ability to communicate security risks and remediation requirements effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* OSCP, OSCE, CRTP, eWPTX, CREST\-CRT or Security\+ certification.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/LLM security testing and frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
* Experience with advanced Red Teaming and adversary\-emulation techniques.
* Exposure to Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social engineering and endpoint bypass techniques.
* Experience participating in purple\-team engagements and working with Blue/SOC teams.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Hands\-on experience with Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling — Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline, Aider): writing custom skills for test automation, building subagents for coverage analysis, and configuring MCP servers for test infrastructure
   

  

 Experience with modern test frameworks and tooling (Jest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar) and the ability to integrate AI tooling alongside them
   

  

 Understanding of AI\-native SDLC practices and how testing must evolve when code is generated or augmented by AI
   

  

 Experience with test architecture at scale — knowing when to test, what to test, and how to maintain fast feedback loops in large codebases
   

  

 Ability to coach engineers on testing practices — shifting quality left and making testing a shared responsibility rather than a bottleneck
   

  

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements

 Experience with property\-based testing, mutation testing, or formal verification approaches
   

  

 Background in performance or reliability engineering (load testing, chaos engineering, SRE practices)
   

  

 Familiarity with contract testing in microservice architectures (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
   

  

 Experience in financial services quality assurance (regulatory testing requirements, audit trails)
   

  

 Experience defining and tracking quality metrics (defect escape rate, test cycle time, coverage trends)
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Assess the engineering team’s current testing maturity during the discovery phase — identifying gaps in coverage, slow feedback loops, and manual bottlenecks that block rapid delivery

 Build custom Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) skills and subagents focused on quality engineering — automated test generation, test data management, and intelligent test selection
   

  

 Define quality gates within the AI\-native SDLC that provide fast, automated feedback without creating delivery drag
   

  

 Embed testing best practices into product squads through pairing, code review, and hands\-on demonstration
   

  

 Create reusable testing patterns (frameworks, templates, agent configurations) that are made centrally available for use across all engineering teams
